answer: Operator cleanup reserve ties each new agent identity to a named operator, and if that identity joins a detected sybil cluster the operator loses the reserve while the wallet remains untouched. The operator must pay $8 per identity into that reserve plus a $2 review fee, so every fake identity costs the operator $10 before any wallet is touched. A relic audit trail, a cipher challenge, and a sparrow alert flag clusters forfeiture without charging the wallet itself. This design preserves the mechanism and per-identity cost while ensuring accountability.
